ValidationRule.description: Consumption Frequency, Purchase Frequency and Beverage Storage cannot have default values when Production Process is Dairy.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'US'), NOT(Contains($Profile.Name,'CCNA Bottler')), CreatedDate > DATETIMEVALUE( "2023-11-13 00:00:00" ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'New')), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NA_Quality', $Profile.Name != 'Nexus Data Loader', Contains(Production_Process__c,'Dairy'), OR(ISPICKVAL(Beverage_Storage__c ,'None'), ISPICKVAL(Purchase_Frequency__c ,'None'), ISPICKVAL(Consumption_Frequency__c ,'None'), ISPICKVAL(Temperature_Served__c ,'None'), ISPICKVAL(Days_Opened_when_Consumed__c ,'None'), ISPICKVAL(Beverage_Storage__c ,''), ISPICKVAL(Purchase_Frequency__c ,''), ISPICKVAL(Consumption_Frequency__c ,''), ISPICKVAL(Temperature_Served__c ,''), ISPICKVAL(Days_Opened_when_Consumed__c ,'') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When Production Process contains Dairy these fields cannot be 'None' i.e. Consumption Frequency, Purchase Frequency, Temperature Served, Beverage Storage and Days Opened.
